gamefaqs.section: GameBoy Advance Pro Action Replay Save (North America)

format: SharkPort save ("SharkPortSave", kind 0x000F0000): title "POKEMON RUBY", date "Legit Celebi Save", notes "From the JAA Stop in Chicago. Nature is Impish."; cart header "POKEMON RUBY" / 'AXVE' (complement 0x41); payload 65536 bytes; checksum: unsigned
